title: SOS/confessions: monotonic uptime time source by default
description: Gap 4 of a6qg: rate-limiting time source defaults to wall-clock time.time in SosResource and ConfessionsResource (also SosRelay); spec 18.4.1/18.10.3 require monotonic uptime. time_func is injectable but production wiring passes none. Fix: default constructors to time.monotonic. Update green doc tests test_time_source_defaults_to_wall_clock_today (SOS line ~761 and confessions line ~1048). Run FULL python suite for fallout.
